component.name: TVGuide
component.script:
SLOT_COUNT = 4 ' show NOW + next 3 SLOT_WIDTH = 380 ROW_HEIGHT = 92 VISIBLE_ROWS = 10 CHANNEL_COL = 260
sub init() m.top.backgroundColor = "0x0A0A0AFF" m.title = m.top.findNode("guideTitle") m.header = m.top.findNode("headerRow") m.rowsGroup = m.top.findNode("rowsGroup") m.hint = m.top.findNode("hintLabel") m.selectedRow = 0 m.rows = [] end sub
sub onChannelsSet() ' Build header (time columns) buildHeader() ' Build one visible row per channel (up to VISIBLE_ROWS) buildRows() m.selectedRow = 0 drawFocus() end sub
sub buildHeader() m.header.removeChildrenIndex(m.header.getChildCount(), 0) ' Channel column label addLabelTo(m.header, "CHANNEL", 0, 0, 260, 60, "font:SmallBoldSystemFont", "0xAAAAAAFF") ' Time headers: NOW, +30, +1h, +1.5h etc. (use current time) now = CreateObject("roDateTime") now.ToLocalTime() hour = now.GetHours() minute = now.GetMinutes() for i = 0 to 3 x = 260 + (i * 380) if i = 0 labelText = "NOW " + formatTime(hour, minute) else ' Add ~30min * i (but round to real forward times) m2 = minute + (i * 30) h2 = hour + (m2 \ 60) m2 = m2 mod 60 h2 = h2 mod 24 labelText = formatTime(h2, m2) end if addLabelTo(m.header, labelText, x, 0, 380, 60, "font:SmallBoldSystemFont", "0xAAAAAAFF") end for end sub
function formatTime(h as Integer, m as Integer) as String ampm = "AM" hh = h if hh = 0 then hh = 12 if hh > 12 hh = hh - 12 ampm = "PM" else if hh = 12 ampm = "PM" end if mm = m.ToStr() if Len(mm) = 1 then mm = "0" + mm return hh.ToStr() + ":" + mm + " " + ampm end function
sub buildRows() m.rowsGroup.removeChildrenIndex(m.rowsGroup.getChildCount(), 0) m.rows = [] channels = m.top.channels if channels = invalid then return n = channels.Count() if n > 10 then n = 10 for i = 0 to n - 1 ch = channels[i] row = m.rowsGroup.createChild("Group") row.translation = [0, i * 92] ' Background rectangle bg = row.createChild("Rectangle") bg.color = "0x14141AFF" bg.width = 1780 bg.height = 84 bg.translation = [0, 4] bg.id = "rowBg" ' Channel name addLabelTo(row, ch.name, 20, 24, 240, 40, "font:SmallBoldSystemFont", "0xFFFFFFFF") ' Compute what plays in next 4 slots (30-min windows) slots = getUpcomingSlots(ch, 4) for j = 0 to 3 x = 260 + (j * 380) slotBg = row.createChild("Rectangle") slotBg.width = 372 slotBg.height = 76 slotBg.translation = [x, 8] slotBg.color = "0x1F1F2AFF" if j = 0 then slotBg.color = "0x2A1F4AFF" slotLabel = "—" if slots.Count() > j and slots[j] <> invalid slotLabel = slots[j].title end if addLabelTo(row, slotLabel, x + 10, 30, 352, 40, "font:SmallSystemFont", "0xEEEEEEFF") end for m.rows.Push(row) end for end sub
sub addLabelTo(parent as Object, txt as String, x as Integer, y as Integer, w as Integer, h as Integer, fnt as String, color as String) lbl = parent.createChild("Label") lbl.text = txt lbl.translation = [x, y] lbl.width = w lbl.height = h lbl.horizAlign = "left" lbl.vertAlign = "center" lbl.font = fnt lbl.color = color lbl.maxLines = 1 lbl.ellipsizeOnBoundary = true end sub
' Returns titles of the next `count` 30-minute slots for a channel. ' The video that plays in a 30-min window is whichever video would ' be playing at the START of that window per the sync algorithm. function getUpcomingSlots(ch as Object, count as Integer) as Object slots = [] nowUtc = getUtcSeconds() for i = 0 to count - 1 offset = nowUtc + (i * 1800) ' + i * 30 min s = getCurrentVideo(ch, offset) if s <> invalid slots.Push(s.video) else slots.Push(invalid) end if end for return slots end function
function getUtcSeconds() as Integer dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") return dt.AsSeconds() end function
sub drawFocus() for i = 0 to m.rows.Count() - 1 row = m.rows[i] bg = row.getChild(0) ' first child is rowBg if i = m.selectedRow bg.color = "0x7C3AEDAA" else bg.color = "0x14141AFF" end if end for end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" m.top.closed = true return true end if if key = "up" m.selectedRow = Max(0, m.selectedRow - 1) drawFocus() return true end if if key = "down" m.selectedRow = Min(m.rows.Count() - 1, m.selectedRow + 1) drawFocus() return true end if if key = "OK" or key = "play" m.top.selectedChannelIndex = m.selectedRow return true end if return false end function
function Max(a as Integer, b as Integer) as Integer if a > b then return a return b end function function Min(a as Integer, b as Integer) as Integer if a < b then return a return b end function

Label.text: Up/Down: Select channel • OK: Tune in • Back: Return
